mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 35 degrees with overcast skies at Badger Prairie County Park under a full moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.
The City of Verona has released candidate packets for the 2027 spring election with all four aldermanic seats up for grabs, and property tax bills will be mailed no later than December 15.

Today features Yoga at Insight Wellness and ART House 360 Thursday Nights, while tomorrow brings live music at Bailey's Run, the 50th-anniversary celebration at Wisconsin Brewing Company, and the Crafty Fair.
Verona police officers handled a variety of incidents between November 1 and November 15, including a notable traffic crash that occurred on November 1.
Culver's is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM, serving today's flavor of the day until they close at 10:00 PM.
